entries.en: Dammit... I wanna go home...
I don't wanna go to school...[n]This sucks...
I'm so tired every day...
I don't want to go to work...
Are there any[n]breaks coming up?
I wonder what the Phantom[n]Thieves' goal is...
Are they just[n]choosing bad people[n]to steal hearts from?
Maybe someone's asking[n]them to do it.
Oh yeah, don't they have[n]a forum or something?
What if you make a[n]request on there and[n]they follow through?
What's gonna happen if we[n]hit Medjed's deadline?
I'm sure the Phantom[n]Thieves will do[n]something about it...
We don't even know[n]who Medjed is... What[n]can they do about it?
August 21st is the deadline,[n]right? I can't wait!
Aw man, we have to[n]wait a whole month?
Another corporate scandal?[n]Haven't there been a lot of[n]those lately?
What is Medjed doing?
It's hard to tell when they[n]aren't making any moves...
The Phantom Thieves have[n]kept their silence too...
Is our country gonna be done[n]for when the deadline comes?
One week left until[n]Medjed's attack...
I wonder what's[n]going to happen...
Didn't they say they would[n]confiscate our possessions?
We have nothing to do with this![n]Why is this happening to us!?
How will the Phantom Thieves[n]take responsibility for this?
Tomorrow's the day, isn't it!?
Are the Phantom Thieves[n]even doing anything?
Hey! What are we gonna do!?
I should never have trusted[n]the Phantom Thieves...
What's going to[n]happen tomorrow...?
I heard the bank servers[n]got taken over...
That has to be fake,[n]right? There's no way!
I'm scared... What's[n]going to happen?
Are the police taking action...?[n]They're ignoring it? Seriously!?
Still, I'm sure the Phantom[n]Thieves will do... something...
He's so annoying![n]I wish the Phantom Thieves[n]would take care of him...
That would be awesome![n]Why not make a request[n]on the forum?
That Akechi is all[n]talk, isn't he?
Why is he so hostile toward[n]the Phantom Thieves?
Right!? Some people just[n]can't read the mood...
Okumura Foods? Like that[n]guy on the rankings?
Apparently the windows[n]at their office got busted.
Whoa, what happened?[n]That's scary...
Was it the Phantom[n]Thieves? Eh, no way...
I wouldn't put[n]it past them...
When is President Okumura[n]gonna get down and beg[n]for forgiveness?
The sooner they get it done,[n]the better it is for society.
We're counting on you, Phantom[n]Thieves... Don't let us down.
Those politicians and[n]Okumura both deserve[n]divine punishment!
Aw, this place is sold out of[n]Phantom Thieves merch too?
The trains are stopped again?
It's like there's a new[n]scandal every day.
Must be nice to be young and[n]excited about phantom thieves.
I hope I get a big summer bonus!
Another election? How many times[n]are they gonna do this?
President Okumura died.[n]Is this just a coincidence...?
Is there an illness that[n]could cause that...?
Nah, no way...
So it was murder?[n]That's terrifying...
This might be the biggest[n]event of the century!
Haven't a lot of people been[n]losing their minds lately...?
Yeah, there's been[n]a sudden increase.
I bet it's because[n]of that Phan-Site.
I heard the victims were[n]on the rankings there.
We should really be blaming[n]the people who requested it.
I heard about another[n]breakdown... This time[n]it's a company exec.
Again!? Ever since[n]Okumura, there have[n]been so many...
The Phantom Thieves are[n]going way too far...
Are they getting carried away[n]by their popularity?
Are the police going to[n]do anything about this?
That should put an[n]end to the case...
It's just like[n]Shido-san said!
We can't go wrong leaving[n]things to Masayoshi Shido.
Shido-san's gonna be in[n]this election too, right?
Politicians like him[n]are promising!
I saw another campaign car.
All the news ever talks[n]about is the election...
It's weird for it to be[n]given this much attention.
Well, we might be getting[n]a new administration, so...
When are the polls again?[n]Is it still a ways off?
Did you see that public[n]opinion survey?
There's overwhelming support[n]for Shido-san's party...
It's like Shido-mania.
A strong leader is just[n]what we need right now.
Please change this[n]country, Mr. Shido!
What's gonna happen[n]to the election?
Oh, that Phantom Thieves thing?[n]It probably doesn't matter.
He said the claims[n]were baseless.
It must be a smear campaign[n]by the opposition.[n]How low is that?
I'm worried about Shido-san.[n]I don't want him to lose...
Did you see that public[n]opinion survey?
There's overwhelming support[n]for Masayoshi Shido's party...
I'd rather trust Shido-san[n]than some phantom thieves.
What we really need right[n]now is a strong leader.
Please change this[n]country, Mr. Shido!
The polling place[n]was really packed...
Here are the latest of the[n]exit polls. As you can see...
I'm curious to see the[n]commentary on the election.
He's practically guaranteed[n]to win! I knew it!
Shinjuku had a high[n]voter turnout, likely due to[n]Shido's following.
Work? I have the day off[n]today. I can't be feeling sick[n]when I get a promotion.
I don't remember having[n]fancy clothes like this. It's[n]like they're for a night job...
Huh? You're not an employee[n]here? C'mon, I know you were[n]working here last year.
Let's take it easy instead[n]of going crazy trying to[n]hit our quota, huh?
You're going to work?[n]I thought you quit?
Every day is so boring...
I don't care if it's just[n]courtesy, I want chocolate...
Whaaa? You're giving[n]him chocolate?
Watch where you're[n]going, old man...
Who cares about[n]Valentine's Day,[n]anyway...
